result.title: SmartSalesBench: A Resistance-Aware Multi-Turn Benchmark for Evaluating LLM Sales Agents
result.summary: We present SmartSalesBench, the first multi-turn conversational benchmark explicitly designed to evaluate large language model (LLM) sales agents against psychologically grounded, resistant buyer personas. Existing task-oriented dialogue benchmarks assume cooperative users and measure task completion; SmartSalesBench inverts this assumption, placing agents against personas programmed to resist and challenge across conversations of up to twenty turns. The benchmark includes five agent profiles, twelve buyer personas, fifteen smartphone products across six price tiers, and four controlled experiments with 3 iterations totaling 13,680 sessions. Both sales-agent and buyer persona generations are grounded through retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). We introduce nine evaluation metrics grouped into three tiers: primary outcome metrics (CR, BRS, RIR), secondary quality metrics (SMS, PFS, ETI), and exploratory metrics planned for future reporting (ITS, ARI, SPI). Our evaluation combines automated LLM-as-judge scoring with internal human assessment (n = 50, \k{appa} = 0.71, Pearson r = 0.81 with BRS).

AI.brief_summary: 提出 SmartSalesBench，一个面向 LLM 销售代理的多轮对话基准：用会被设定为「抵抗、质疑」的买家画像替代合作型用户，涵盖五种代理配置、十二种买家画像、十五款手机与四组受控实验（共 13,680 段会话，最长 20 轮），对话生成靠 RAG 支撑，并提出分三层的九项指标，评测结合 LLM-as-judge 与人工标注。
AI.relevance_reason: 其对抗式多轮评测与「坚持还是终止」的判定，可能为 LVR 中 STOP 决策的成本收益刻画和交互轮数预算的设计提供外部参照；但该工作不涉及视觉输入或 latent 推理状态，联系仅为推测，可供核查。
